title: Freeze-frame plan (per-language)
description: Records, for one dub track produced under freeze-frame policy, how the picture is re-timed at cue boundaries to track the back-to-back dubbed audio. Written at audio/freeze-plan.<lang>.json by run_dub when quality_bars.audio.freeze_frame_enabled is on. Two modes (see `mode`): hold-only (Model B) emits only `freezes` — where the audio runs later than the picture, hold the frame; a one-sided residual is left honest. Trim mode (Model A, for languages in quality_bars.audio.freeze_trim_languages) also emits `trims` — where the audio runs earlier than the picture, skip that much source so the picture catches up (residual 0 by construction). Consumed at mux time (packaging.run_mux) to re-time the picture to the audio, and at package time to re-offset the standalone caption deliverables onto the post-adjust timeline. `at_ms` is the insertion point on the ORIGINAL (pre-adjust) video timeline (the corrected cue's caption_start_ms). Empty `freezes`/`trims` arrays are legitimate, informative (freeze mode on, nothing needed adjusting).

mode.description: hold = Model B (freeze-only, honest residual); trim = Model A (freeze + trim source → residual 0).

quality_bars.description: Snapshot of the freeze-frame quality bars used to compute this plan.

at_ms.description: Insertion point on the original (pre-adjust) timeline; the corrected cue's caption_start_ms.

freeze_ms.description: How long to hold the frozen frame (the running audio-vs-picture gap absorbed at this boundary).

natural_ms.description: True un-stretched TTS duration of the cue.

tail.description: True for the single tail-reconciliation entry: a picture-length adjustment (at_ms == source_duration_ms) that makes the picture END where the dub audio ends, rather than a cue-start boundary event. Excluded from the sync-report per-cue residual accounting (it reuses the last cue's id); applied by the mux/windows, which key events by at_ms.

trims.description: Trim mode (Model A) only: where the picture is shortened by skipping source frames so it catches up to the earlier-running audio. Empty in hold mode.

at_ms.description: Trim point on the original (pre-adjust) timeline; the corrected cue's caption_start_ms.

trim_ms.description: How much source picture to skip (the running picture-ahead-of-audio gap removed at this boundary).

natural_ms.description: True un-stretched TTS duration of the cue.

tail.description: True for the single tail-reconciliation entry: a picture-length trim (at_ms == source_duration_ms - trim_ms) that makes the picture END where the dub audio ends, rather than a cue-start boundary event. Excluded from the sync-report per-cue residual accounting; applied by the mux/windows.
